svg.aria-label: Flowchart: one vacancy through the jobsearch plugin. All counts are made up for the drawing (synthetic data).
svg.title: The path of a vacancy

g.aria-label: scan: looks through the job boards you chose and brings back 12 new vacancies
g.data-n: scan: looks through the job boards you chose and brings back 12 new vacancies

g.aria-label: rank: checks duplicates, blockers and match. 5 of 12 go on to apply, 7 are skipped
g.data-n: rank: checks duplicates, blockers and match. 5 of 12 go on to apply, 7 are skipped

g.aria-label: apply: prepares 5 tailored CV and cover letter drafts, each checked against your facts. Nothing is sent
g.data-n: apply: prepares 5 tailored CV and cover letter drafts, each checked against your facts. Nothing is sent

g.aria-label: send by hand: you read the drafts and send the 5 applications yourself. The plugin never sends or clicks Apply
g.data-n: send by hand: you read the drafts and send the 5 applications yourself. The plugin never sends or clicks Apply

g.aria-label: outcome: records what came back in the tracker. Here 2 replies and 3 with no reply yet
g.data-n: outcome: records what came back in the tracker. Here 2 replies and 3 with no reply yet

g.aria-label: followup: lists applications waiting too long and drafts 3 polite follow-ups. Drafts only
g.data-n: followup: lists applications waiting too long and drafts 3 polite follow-ups. Drafts only

g.aria-label: funnel: the report, bars to scale. 12 found, 5 worth applying, 5 sent, 2 replies
g.data-n: funnel: the report, bars to scale. 12 found, 5 worth applying, 5 sent, 2 replies

g.aria-label: skipped: 7 vacancies with a blocker or a low match stay in the tracker and are never hidden
g.data-n: skipped: 7 vacancies with a blocker or a low match stay in the tracker and are never hidden
